scripts.build: npm run build -w @wap/dsl && npm run build -w @wap/db && npm run build -w @wap/mcp-task-hub && npm run build -w @wap/engine && npm run build -w @wap/api && npm run build -w @wap/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:unit -w @wap/engine && npm run test:unit -w @wap/api && npm run test:unit -w @wap/web && npm run schema:json && npm run api:generate
scripts.check:backend: npm run check && npm run test:integration -w @wap/mcp-task-hub && npm run test:integration -w @wap/engine && npm run test:integration -w @wap/api
scripts.check:full: npm run check:backend && npm run check:web
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/dsl/src packages/dsl/tests packages/dsl/scripts packages/db/src apps/mcp-task-hub/src apps/mcp-task-hub/tests apps/mcp-task-hub/vitest.integration.config.ts packages/engine/src packages/engine/tests packages/engine/vitest.integration.config.ts apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.db:migrate:g1: npm run build -w @wap/db && node packages/db/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:seed:g1: npm run build -w @wap/db && node packages/db/dist/cli.js seed
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration -w @wap/mcp-task-hub && npm run test:integration -w @wap/engine && npm run test:integration -w @wap/api
scripts.check:g1: npm run check && npm run test:integration -w @wap/mcp-task-hub
